name: EXIF Integrity Validation
description: Validates EXIF data structure integrity by checking mandatory camera fields, field consistency, version compliance, and metadata completeness. Detects anomalies in EXIF data that indicate AI generation or post-processing tampering.
mechanism:
The EXIF integrity validator examines:

1. **Mandatory Field Presence**: Checks for essential camera EXIF fields (Make, Model, ExifVersion, DateTimeOriginal, FocalLength, ExposureTime, FNumber, ISO). Genuine camera images contain most of these fields.

2. **Field Value Consistency**: Cross-validates related fields — e.g., DateTimeOriginal should precede DateTimeDigitized; ExifVersion should match known standards.

3. **Structure Completeness**: Calculates an integrity ratio based on how many mandatory fields are present vs expected. High ratio indicates authentic camera capture.

4. **Version Compliance**: Validates ExifVersion against known JEITA standards (0220-0232).
parameters:
Mandatory camera fields: Make, Model, ExifVersion, DateTimeOriginal, FocalLength, ExposureTime, FNumber, ISOSpeedRatings

Excluded basic info: File Name, File Size, MIME Type, Last Modified, Format

Supported EXIF versions: 0220, 0221, 0230, 0231, 0232
accuracy: High - 80-90% accuracy for images with intact EXIF data. Less effective when metadata has been stripped.
source: JEITA CP-3451C (Exif Standard 2.32), ISO 12234-1 (TIFF/EP), CIPA DC-007 (Multi-Picture Format)
useCase: Second-pass metadata validation: verifies EXIF structural integrity after initial metadata scan to identify subtle tampering or fabrication. Essential for forensic workflows requiring comprehensive metadata authentication.
strengths:
• Comprehensive multi-field validation catches inconsistencies AI tools miss
• Cross-validation between related fields provides high confidence
• Works on all JPEG and TIFF-based formats
• Low computational overhead — instant results
• Detects both AI generation and metadata stripping/fabrication
limitations:
• Completely stripped EXIF data produces no result (inconclusive)
• Some apps intentionally strip EXIF for privacy
• AI tools are improving at generating realistic EXIF data
• Social media platforms strip most EXIF fields
• Cannot validate EXIF data that has been manually crafted

references.title: JEITA CP-3451C — Exchangeable Image File Format (Exif) Version 2.32
Farid, H. (2019). Image Forensics. Annual Review of Vision Science.
